steps.title: Get yourself a ring of suffering …
steps.text: Get yourself a ring of suffering from Demonic gorillas. — Ideally do this on task. — You can use Arclight for a good melee weapon. — Arclight is storable in a STASH unit. You will want it later. — You could also go for a necklace of anguish, but honestly the extra defense, magic attack, and prayer bonus on the fury is very nice for the upcoming sections. — (Optional) You could choose to completely skip the Suffering and just make recoils manually at Zulrah. Technically the Suffering is an optional upgrade, but it is really nice to have. — You should ONLY consider this if you are already experienced at the fight. Don't do this if you are learning Zulrah on a UIM, just get the ring.

steps.title: Kill Zulrah until you get a …
steps.text: Kill Zulrah until you get a Tanzanite fang. — this video has some tips on using the Twinflame staff. Using the pillar stalling makes a huge difference! — Keep in mind that the Toxic Blowpipe is a good candidate for storage at the Blue Moon boss when you don't need it. — Sunfire runes are a nice damage upgrade, and can be made in bulk using Twisted extracts. — An ornate rejuvenation pool is very nice to restore after each kill. — The Cure Me spell is a good alternative to anti-venom potions, but can't be used with the Twinflame staff. — Keep the stack of antidotes you get to use at Araxxor later. — You can use 2 doses of anti-venom per kill and still profit antidotes on average. — Adjust the supplies to match your stats and method.
